## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Implements the texture viewer part of https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6544

## Additional information

<!--
Provide additional information and explanation of your PR, including areas that you are uncertain of or require special attention from reviewers. For examples, please read our pull request guidelines: https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/pull_requests/pull_request_guidelines.html#explain-your-contributions
-->

What's implemented:

- Show the panel only when the selected node is part of the lightmap: A `LightmapGI` node, a `MeshInstance3D`, a `Node3D` that implements `get_bake_meshes()` (like the `GridMap` node), and a instanced scene which nodes are part of the lightmap.
- The selected node will highlight its island.
- When selecting an island on the lightmap texture or list the node will be also selected in the scene tree dock.
- When double-clicking on an island on the lightmap texture or list the node will be focused in the first 3D viewport.
- Switch between the lightmap and the shadowmask if available.
- Show/hide the UVs for the whole layer if no island is selected or the specific selected island.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/319265d1-11e4-4745-83e6-a2de271c835a


Opened as a draft as there are still a couple minor bugs but it's usable enough and I'd like if people could give their opinions.


No AI was used.
